description: This file is a CMake module script used to locate and set up the DBusClient library for a build system. It includes conditional logic to find packages, libraries, and headers needed for DBusClient integration, and defines an imported library target.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Finds a package, in this case, PkgConfig, to assist with locating libraries and headers.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the presence of specified pkg-config modules, here 'dbus-client'.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Locates a library file for dbus_client.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Locates the header file DbusClient.h needed for compilation.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates an imported target for the DBusClient library.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Configures properties for the imported library target, including link interfaces and include directories.
